items.Sentence: Existing plant operations and processes include preliminary treatment with bar screening and grit removal, primary treatment with primary sedimentation tanks, secondary treatment with trickling filters and secondary sedimentation, disinfection with sodium hypochlorite, and dechlorination with sodium bisulfite.
